events.name: BOBBY ALU w/ COLOSO
events.info: Bobby Alu w/ Coloso DuoSoul'd Out Presents: Bobby Alu w/ Coloso Duo Doors: 7:00pm Show: 8:00pm Ages 21+. https://www.bobbyalu.com/ https://colosoband.com/ If you ask Byron Bay's Bobby Alu what his music sounds like, he'll tell you how he hopes it makes you feel: like you have your favourite drink in hand, sipping as the sun sets on a balmy evening that's laden with the promise of adventure. In an ideal world, he'd follow summer around the earth, in his endless quest to nail that feeling in his songs. For Bobby it's all about letting the music decide where it takes you - creatively and physically - and following the threads of curiosity large, small and often strange. It's playing ukulele with old friends at the local market in exchange for a box of vegetables, because how weird is it to improvise along to people buying bananas at 7am on a Tuesday? It's going to Ghana with just a hunch and a WhatsApp number to track down the rhythms that lit up his heart. It's touring the world for five years as Xavier Rudd's percussionist, learning how to be in service to the vibe of a room, and how to make the jump to being an international performer in his own right. It's honouring his Samoan heritage through sharing the stage and releasing an EP with his mother to connect with the language of her homeland. Always, it's about being open to discovery: if you choose music, you choose it all. -------------------------------------- Special Note: Ticket holders for this show receive free admission to Jack London's Burly Q Revue Cabaret after the music! Notes on Seating: Open seating, may be limited or standing room only. First come, first seated. Open dance floor may obscure sightlines.

events.name: PAHUA with Colectivo Cenizas
events.info: PahuaSoul'd Out Productions Presents: Pahua Doors: 7:00pm Show: 8:00pm Ages 21+ Mexican singer, producer, and DJ blending Latin rhythms with alternative electronic sounds. Think vibes like Nidia Góngora, Mitú, or YoSoyMatt, but with fusions that spotlight Latin America's rich musical heritage. Over 20 million streams across platforms and featured on 12+ editorial playlists covers on Spotify, Amazon Music, Tidal, and more. She was selected as Spotify's EQUAL Mexico ambassador, appeared in Amazon Music's ROMPE program, and recorded a couple tracks for Apple Music's Arrullos Mexicanos Vol. 1, nominated for a Latin GRAMMY. Her music has been synced in video games like EA Sports FC '24 and '26, The Sims, and TV series as AppleTV+'s Messi Meets America, as well as in commercials like Walmart's nationwide back-to-school campaign ad. Outlets like Colors, KEXP, Rolling Stone, BBC Radio, NPR, Remezcla, and Sounds & Colors are already paying attention. A creative force with a bold sound and a one-of-a-kind style.

events.name: NIGHTMARES & DAYDREAMS: A Dark Cabaret and Pole Fantasy
events.info: From the producer of the hit Pop Princess comes a brand-new journey into the surreal.Nightmares & Daydreams is an immersive evening of pole, burlesque, drag, and theatrical performance where dreams blur into nightmares and fantasy takes center stage.From hauntingly beautiful to delightfully bizarre, each act explores a different corner of the dreamscape through movement, music, storytelling, and unforgettable characters. Expect an evening of dark glamour, surreal imagination, playful fantasy, and eerie spectacle as every performer brings their own unique vision to life.Featuring returning fan favorites Atlas, Bambi Bitters, Hibiscus Lust, and Katness, alongside exciting new performers NVi, Nadia Desdemona, Jax, Jack Dickastrap, Christie, and Glambona.Whether youre drawn to the eerie, the whimsical, the seductive, or the unexpected, theres a dream waiting for you.Come lose yourself in the dream.
